eventPolicy.T1: first ISSUE of TC1 only; later downgrade to TC1 is not a T1 issue event
eventPolicy.T3: first upward transition to TC3 from a lower signal; downgrade from TC8/9/10 is excluded
eventPolicy.T8: first upward transition to any TC8NE/TC8SE/TC8SW/TC8NW from below T8; direction changes and downgrades are excluded
eventPolicy.skippedLowerSignal: if a higher signal is issued before an eligible lower-signal event, the lower signal is recorded as not-issued/skipped and is not scored

evidenceCoveragePolicy.checkpointRule: A forecast checkpoint is scoreable only when its selected prospective snapshot is healthy and no older than the checkpoint freshness limit.
evidenceCoveragePolicy.lifecycleRule: Stable-lead and reversal stability are scoreable only across continuous healthy prospective coverage with the case present throughout the claimed interval.
evidenceCoveragePolicy.noSignalRule: A no-signal closeout requires at least 24 hours of overlapping continuous healthy prospective absence and HKO truth polling health; wall-clock time alone never advances absence coverage.
evidenceCoveragePolicy.historicalCloseoutRule: No-signal closeouts completed before policy effectiveAt remain grandfathered so the new health ledger does not retroactively invalidate already-finalized cases.
evidenceCoveragePolicy.immutableEvidence: Coverage guards only qualify derived evaluation evidence; raw prospective and HKO truth corpora remain immutable.

closeoutPolicy.noSignalCase: A case that has carried an HKO source may close without TC1 only after it disappears from a healthy settled prospective capture and remains absent for at least 24 hours.
closeoutPolicy.warnedCase: Once an HKO warning episode has started, missing higher signals close only on HKO CANCEL or CLEAR_DETECTED.
closeoutPolicy.unresolvedTruthGuard: Any unresolved or ambiguous eligible HKO signal event in the relevant interval blocks automatic negative closeout.
closeoutPolicy.negativeScoring: Not-issued signals receive no A/B/C/D timing grade; forecast evidence retains backward-compatible correct-negative/transient-false-alarm/stable-false-alarm classification plus separate possible/likely severity and terminal lifecycle diagnostics.
closeoutPolicy.immutableEvidence: Closeout is derived from trusted beta-prospective-recorder/v2 observations and HKO truth events; raw corpora are never rewritten.
